title: Paying a billable invoice on the portal works as before
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Have a portal contact for this test for customer A, whose portal login the tester can use, and a test card.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, invoiced, billable, unpaid.
custom_steps:
1. Sign in to the customer portal as customer A's contact.
  2. Pay work order 1's invoice with the test card.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The portal opens with work order 1's invoice.

Step 2:

  • The portal confirms the payment, and work order 1's invoice shows Paid in ShopView.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)
